old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-r50b","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: EDHOC th_4 uses plaintext instead of CIPHERTEXT_3 per RFC 9528","description":"In rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:902-912, the commit clones ciphertext_3.0 into data_3 BEFORE encrypt_in_place_detached mutates it, then uses data_3 (plaintext) for transcript_4. RFC 9528 Section 5.4.2 specifies TH_4 = H(TH_3, CIPHERTEXT_3, CRED_I) where CIPHERTEXT_3 is the COSE_Encrypt0 ciphertext produced by message 3 encryption. Using the pre-encryption plaintext violates the EDHOC spec.
